title: fix(auth): the forgot-password page says a reset link can't be emailed on a deployment that sends no mail (#30366)

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgFVwD1YUYrxV6tnaLG5nxgi)_

domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

Fixes #30366

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：忘记密码页在服务端报告 `features.emailDelivery: false`（没接邮件服务或只用 log 传输）时，提交后不再说「已发送重置链接」，改为「此处无法通过邮件发送重置链接，请联系管理员在 设置 → 用户 中为你设置新密码」，十种语言齐全。
- 为什么改：不发邮件的部署上，用户会一直等一封永远不来的邮件；服务端一半（#30107，PR #30365）已经提供这个开关，这里是界面一半。
- 风险与回滚：只有明确的 `false` 才换文案；老服务端不带这个字段、或取配置失败，保持现在的文案。新文案不含地址、与提交结果无关，不会泄露账号是否存在。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/auth/src/ForgotPasswordForm.tsx`（成功页分支）、`ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/forgot-password-success-message.test.tsx`（新 describe 块）、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ForgotPasswordPage.tsx`（两行 label 传递）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/forgot-password-success-message.test.tsx`，预期 10/10 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ForgotPasswordForm` reads `features.emailDelivery` from the `/auth/config` answer it already fetches (alongside `phoneNumberOtp`). On an explicit `false` the success screen shows `noDeliveryTitle` / `noDeliveryDescription` — "A reset link can't be emailed here" / "This deployment doesn't send email, so no password reset link can reach you. Ask an administrator: they can set a new password for you from Setup → Users." — with an amber icon instead of the green one. The submit still goes to the server, so a log-transport deployment keeps writing the link to its console.
- `ForgotPasswordFormLabels` gains `noDeliveryTitle` and `noDeliveryDescription`; `AuthPublicConfig.features` gains `emailDelivery` (the server half's `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema.emailDelivery`).
- New strings `auth.forgotPassword.noDeliveryTitle` and `auth.forgotPassword.noDeliveryDescription` in all ten locale packs, passed through by the Console's forgot-password page (label wiring only, per the claim's file-surface ruling) and by `DefaultForgotPasswordPage` in `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- Changeset: `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console`, all `patch` (Metadata-protocol none).

## Why

On a deployment with no mail transport, every reset request ended on "Check your email — we've sent a password reset link to …", and nothing arrived. The server half (#30107, PR #30365) now says whether mail leaves the deployment; this is the page reading it.

**An absent key keeps today's text.** The spec text for the flag says absent means not live, but on the wire an absent key means a server older than the flag, and most of those do send mail; telling their users to find an administrator would be the larger harm. A failed config fetch is the same unknown. So only `emailDelivery === false` swaps the screen, and both unknowns are pinned to keep the "check your email" text.

**No account-existence oracle.** The new text names no address and is chosen by the deployment flag alone, never by the reset request's answer (which is the same for known and unknown addresses server-side). A test submits a known and an unknown address on a no-mail deployment and asserts the two screens are byte-identical and carry no address.

## Tests

- `forgot-password-success-message.test.tsx` — new top-level describe (objectstack#30366) in the existing harness file: no-mail screen text and no address; known vs unknown address read identically; caller-supplied labels used; `emailDelivery: true`, absent key, and failed fetch each keep the old screen.

<details><summary>Local runs (head 74302c6d after merging origin/main; the merge brought no ui/ paths)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/auth/src/__tests__/forgot-password-success-message.test.tsx …/identifier-trim.test.tsx …/phoneTouchTargets-29080.test.tsx` — Test Files 3 passed, Tests 14 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/` — Test Files 95 passed, Tests 1443 passed / 13 skipped (key parity included).
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/auth --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/console --concurrency=2` — Tasks 76 successful, 76 total.
- eslint on the changed ts/tsx files — exit 0. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui) — 0 new citations.
- Ablation via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `setEmailDeliveryOff(config?.features?.emailDelivery === false);` replaced by `setEmailDeliveryOff(false);` — 3 of the new tests fail (no-mail text, known/unknown parity, translated labels), 7 pass; restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. (The three keep-old-text cases pass under the mutation by design.)

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The server half PR #30365 is open at this head. The UI only reads an optional key, so this compiles and runs against today's main (where the key is never sent, and the old text shows). origin/main gets merged again once #30365 lands, before acceptance.
- File surface widened by the claim's ruling A: the two label-passing pages, label lines only. `ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts` (the `emailDelivery` declaration on `AuthPublicConfig.features`) is outside the listed surface: without it the read does not type-check.
